name: Westfield Promenade
description: Westfield Promenade is an open-air lifestyle shopping destination in the heart of Woodland Hills, offering a curated mix of popular retailers, dining, and entertainment in a beautifully landscaped outdoor setting. The center features recognizable brands like H&M, Uniqlo, Starbucks, and Sephora, providing a contemporary shopping experience that caters to the affluent San Fernando Valley community. With its convenient location on Topanga Canyon Boulevard and modern amenities, Westfield Promenade serves as a vibrant gathering place for residents and visitors seeking style, convenience, and quality all in one location.
demographics: Westfield Promenade attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the western San Fernando Valley, with a strong presence of upper-middle-class households earning $75,000-$150,000+ annually. The primary trade area includes young professionals, established families with children, and active retirees who value the open-air lifestyle format and convenient access to quality retail and dining. Visitors tend to be educated, tech-savvy consumers who appreciate the blend of national retailers, specialty shops, and entertainment options in an upscale outdoor setting. The center draws from surrounding Woodland Hills, Calabasas, and West Hills communities known for their suburban affluence and high homeownership rates.
summary: A contemporary open-air lifestyle center in Woodland Hills featuring popular national retailers, dining options, and entertainment in an upscale outdoor environment.
